page.layout: One text column, with Latin and Arabic lines mixed; no marginal notes. Page number top right. Catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: Scriba de quo hæc Ebn Chalecan, لـم يوجد في المتقنين ولا المتاخرين من كتب مثله ولا قاربه وان كان ابو علي بن مقلة اول من دقل هذه الطريقة من خط الكوفيين وابرزهـا في هذه الصورة واه ذلك فضيلة السبع وخطه ايضا في نهاية الحسن لكن ابن البواب هذب طريقته &c. Non repertus est vel inter antiquiores vel recentiores qui ipsi scribendo par aut secundus fuerit, & quamvis Abu Ali Ebn Moklah primus scribendi rationem ab ea Cufi-ensium ad hanc quae jam in usu, transtulerit, & haec [li-terarum] figuram in lucem protulerit, ideoque prioritatis gloria ipsi debeatur, unaque fuerit scriptura ejus in summo elegantiae gradu, tamen Ebnol Bowab ejus rationem concinnavit, &c. Sunt interim qui asserunt Abu Ali Mohammedem istum primum hujus Calligraphiae rationis authorem non fuisse, sed fratrem ipsius ابو عبد الله الحسن Abu Abdollah Al-Hasanum, qui natus est anno H. 278. mortuus 338. Ebnol Bowab autem obiit anno H. 423. vel juxta alios 413. quem ita deflevit doctus quidam, referente Ebn Chalecan,
استشعر الكتاب فقدك بسالفا وقضت بصحة تلك الايام فلذا ك سودت الدوى ع كابة اسفا عليك وشقت الاقلام

p.i: Animadvertit Scriptura desiderari te qui abieras, Ejusque veritatem comprobavit tempus. Ideoque nigra facta sunt atramentaria prae dolore, Ob te contristata, & scissi sunt calami.

page.notes: The Arabic lines are printed in small type and were read with difficulty; the verse lines "استشعر الكتاب فقدك بسالفا" and "فلذا ك سودت الدوى ع كابة" are doubtful. The name in the Arabic line after "fratrem ipsius" is hard to read. No notes in the margins. The catchword "Ebn" is at the lower right.
